verdict.rationale: Bulk handling shows up only as ingestion. Secureframe accepts raw data pushed through an API endpoint or CSV upload and normalizes and maps it for you. It also pulls user data for access reviews via CSV or integrations. A REST API with Lucene search and an MCP server that can 'take actions' let scripts or agents work across many records. None of the evidence documents true bulk operations: no batch endpoints, no multi-select bulk edit, update or delete in the UI, and no bulk tool in the MCP server. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk API endpoints, bulk edit or update actions in the UI or MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-item operations.
